assertions.assertion: Uses a CookieContainer with HttpClientHandler so cookies flow across requests
assertions.rationale: new HttpClientHandler { CookieContainer = cookies } is used to build the HttpClient.

assertions.assertion: Uses AngleSharp (HtmlParser().ParseDocumentAsync) to parse the login page HTML
Reads the antiforgery token from input[name='__RequestVerificationToken'] via GetAttribute("value")
POSTs FormUrlEncodedContent with Username, Password, __RequestVerificationToken, and button=login to the form's resolved action URL
assertions.rationale: PostAsync(action, new FormUrlEncodedContent) with Username, Password, __RequestVerificationToken, button=login, where action = new Uri(RequestUri, form.GetAttribute("action")).

assertions.assertion: Asserts success by comparing the final RequestMessage.RequestUri.Host to the original protected host
assertions.rationale: Asserts result.RequestMessage.RequestUri.Host equals the original app host.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT require Playwright, Selenium, or another headless browser
assertions.rationale: Uses only HttpClient and AngleSharp; says no Playwright/Selenium needed.
